title.narrative: Reducing the burden of TB and TB/HIV co-infection in Solomon Islands

description.narrative: Solomon Islands - Tuberculosis - Solomon Islands Ministry of Health and Medical Services - MHMS. This program has the following goals: GOAL TB: End Tuberculosis in Solomon Islands by 2035.. GOAL TB/HIV: To improve HIV prevention, testing and treatment service coverage in Solomon Islands.. The objectives of this program are: TB OBJECTIVE 1: Universal access to Tuberculosis care and preventive services.. TB OBJECTIVE 2: Build sustainable systems.. TB OBJECTIVE 3: Develop knowledge management systems for Tuberculosis.. HIV OBECTIVE 4: To strengthen HIV testing among key and vulnerable populations.
